description: Track two follow-ups for the tmux sidebar workflow: when the sidebar is not focused, add `Alt-r` to rename the current pane and `Alt-R` to rename the current session; keep fullscreen/zoom mode active when changing panes. Acceptance: rename shortcuts work from normal tmux focus without requiring the sidebar, and fullscreen/zoom does not collapse just because pane focus changed.
title: Add tmux sidebar rename and fullscreen follow-ups
